rationales.rules-based-checks-v3: VibeGuard uses five deterministic static scanners implementing file-pattern, configuration-invariant, parsed source-map, credential-regex, and dependency-policy rules; its coded PolicyEngine applies severity thresholds and hard-block rules to validate whether project artifacts are safe to publish.
